Burberry My Burberry Black is a rich parfum for women, with deep floral, fruity and amber accords. Jasmine opens it, peach nectar and candied rose form an intense heart, and warm amber with patchouli gives a smooth, elegant finish. It is a rich choice for women who like their florals warm and sweet.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Jasmine
  • Heart notes: Peach Nectar, Candied Rose
  • Base notes: Amber, Patchouli

How it wears

This is the darker, sweeter side of My Burberry: jammy rose and ripe peach over an earthy patchouli and amber base. Parfum is the most concentrated of the usual strengths, so a light hand works best. Save it for evenings, colder weather and dressed-up occasions, when its deeper floral and amber character feels right. Spray on pulse points and let it settle before judging the dry-down.

Good to know

  • 50ml spray
  • Parfum
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: My Burberry Black 90ml or My Burberry Eau de Parfum 50ml

For a bright, refined men’s scent, John Varvatos Artisan is an eau de toilette built on citrus, aromatic herbs and smooth woods. Clementine and mandarin meet marjoram and thyme, then orange blossom, ginger and lavender lead to a base of musk, woods and amber.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Clementine, Mandarin Orange, Marjoram, Thyme
  • Heart notes: Orange Blossom, Ginger, Lavender, Jasmine
  • Base notes: Musk, Woody Notes, Amber

How it wears

The juicy citrus and garden herbs give it a sunny, relaxed feel, with ginger keeping the middle lively. It is clean and stylish and works especially well for daytime wear: the office, lunches and warm-weather weekends. The musky, woody base keeps it grown-up as it dries down. Reapply after lunch if you want the citrus back.

Good to know

  • 75ml spray
  • John Varvatos Artisan eau de toilette, a lighter concentration than an eau de parfum
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Davidoff Champion or Calvin Klein Eternity Aromatic Essence mini

Carolina Herrera 212 Sexy Men is a warm, spicy eau de toilette for men with aromatic and woody accords. Fresh mandarin and bergamot give way to cardamom and pepper, and a base of vanilla, sandalwood, guaiac wood, musk and amber makes it smooth and sophisticated.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Green Notes
  • Heart notes: Cardamom, Pepper, Flowers
  • Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Guaiac Wood, Musk, Amber

How it wears

A short burst of citrus and greenery leads into a spiced heart, and the long base is where it shows its character: creamy wood, soft vanilla and the dry warmth of guaiac wood. It is suited to evening wear, nights out and cooler months, rather than a hot day at the desk. A couple of sprays before heading out is plenty.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Carolina Herrera 212 VIP Men or Calvin Klein Defy Parfum

Inspired by a London garden after the rain, Burberry My Burberry is an elegant floral eau de parfum for women. Fresh bergamot and sweet pea open it, geranium, quince and freesia fill the heart, and patchouli with two roses gives a sophisticated, feminine finish.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Sweet Pea, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Geranium Leaf, Golden Quince, Freesia
  • Base notes: Patchouli, Damask Rose, Centifolia Rose

How it wears

It starts green and dewy, then turns softly fruity with golden quince before the rose and patchouli base adds depth. The result feels polished but light enough for daily use. Spring and early autumn suit it well, as do the office, weekend plans and weddings. Spray on the wrists and neck and let the rose come through as it settles.

Good to know

  • 50ml spray
  • Burberry My Burberry eau de parfum, more concentrated than an eau de toilette
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: My Burberry Eau de Parfum 90ml or My Burberry Black Parfum 50ml

Dolce & Gabbana L’Imperatrice is a women’s eau de toilette with juicy fruit, fresh florals and a soft musky finish. Watermelon, kiwi and rhubarb give it a bright, playful character, and smooth woods keep it modern and easy to wear.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Kiwi, Rhubarb, Pink Pepper
  • Heart notes: Watermelon, Cyclamen, Jasmine
  • Base notes: Musk, Sandalwood, Lemon Tree

How it wears

The opening is crisp and green from kiwi and rhubarb, with a small lift of pink pepper. Watermelon, cyclamen and jasmine then give the heart a juicy, light floral feel before musk and sandalwood settle it down. As a Dolce & Gabbana L’Imperatrice eau de toilette it is lighter than an eau de parfum, which makes it a natural choice for daytime, warm weather, the office and weekends.

Good to know

  • 100ml spray
  • Eau de toilette
  • For women
  • 100% authentic, shipped from the UK
  • Also try: Dolce & Gabbana Q or DKNY Be Delicious Orchard Street
